version.changelog:
- Expanded SKILL.md with practical usage scenarios and examples for tracking, pricing, and outlet lookup.
- Clarified feature descriptions, tags, and version information in SKILL.md.
- Removed requirements.txt, security.py, and zto.py, indicating core code and dependencies are no longer included in this version.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only ZTO Express helper with no executable code, though its local-runtime and persistence notes appear stale or aspirational.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is shipment tracking, fee or delivery estimates, service comparison, outlet lookup, and shipment guidance; the artifact contains only SKILL.md, so it does not itself provide live tracking or shipping automation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are bounded to logistics help, asking for missing shipment details, giving cautious estimates, and not claiming real shipping actions unless live tools are available.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, package manifests, executable files, or dependency setup are included in this version.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request credentials, account sessions, cookies, broad local file reads, or network authority.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md discloses possible local storage paths and privacy commands, but no runtime files are present to create or manage that storage in this artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Safe to install as a guidance skill, but treat tracking numbers and address details as private. Be aware that the documented local privacy/runtime commands are not included in this version, so do not assume it can actually manage local history or perform live ZTO actions without separate tools.
